source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-08: Revolution on the Riverside

items.name: Power Attack
items.text:
The guard captain makes a melee Strike.

This counts as two attacks when calculating the multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, it deals an extra a die of weapon damage.

items.name: Sudden Charge
items.text: The guard captain Strides twice. If the guard captain ends their movement within a melee reach of at least one enemy, they can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

items.name: Swipe
items.text: The guard captain makes a single melee Strike and compares the attack roll result to the ACs of up to two foes, each of whom must be within the guard captain's melee reach and adjacent to the other. Roll damage only once and apply it to each creature the guard captain hits. A swipe counts as two attacks for the multiple attack penalty. The modifier of a weapon with a sweep trait applies to all attacks.
